# Editorial photographs

All images are real photographs.

- `kane.webp`: Harry Kane, Salzburg friendly, 6 January 2025. Photo by Werner100359 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FC_Red_Bull_Salzburg_gegen_Bayern_M%C3%BCnchen_(2025-01-06_Testspiel)_28.jpg
- `musiala.webp`: Jamal Musiala, Ecuador v Germany, 25 June 2026. Required photo credit: Bryan Berlin / WikiPortraits / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jamal_Musiala_Ecuador_v_Germany_25_June_2026-174.jpg
- `bayern-running.webp`: Aleksandar Pavlović running during the Salzburg friendly, 6 January 2026. Photo by Werner100359 / Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Source photograph](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FC_RB_Salzburg_gegen_FC_Bayern_M%C3%BCnchen_(2026-01-06_Testspiel)_34.jpg)
- `teammates.webp`: Bayern teammates embracing during the same friendly. Photo by Werner100359 / Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Source photograph](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FC_RB_Salzburg_gegen_FC_Bayern_M%C3%BCnchen_(2026-01-06_Testspiel)_37.jpg)
- `arena-night.webp`: Allianz Arena illuminated red at night. Photo by Richard Bartz (Makro Freak) / Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/). [Source photograph](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Allianz_arena_at_night_Richard_Bartz.jpg)
- `player-tunnel.webp`: Allianz Arena players' tunnel, 21 April 2026. Photo by Cro-Cop / Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [Source photograph](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FC_Bayern_Munich_players_tunnel_Allianz_Arena.jpg)

Files were resized and encoded as WebP. The celebration photo was cropped and the tunnel photo was oriented for display. The page uses CSS crops, gradient overlays and color adjustments. Each derivative retains its listed license. Application code uses a separate MIT license. See the [image records](SOURCES.json) and [site credits](../../visual-credits.html).
